result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 8-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

BUDDY — BUDDY BUDS.
Identity: exact lean young man with forehead goggles, white T-shirt, gold necklace and green pendant, loose blue jeans and brown boots. Keep his glass flask and camouflage bag. Yellow-green plant leaves and earth-toned buds, never turquoise effects.
0–1.2s: establish full-body BUDDY with the bag at his boots. He gives three tiny suspended seeds one measured drop from his flask, then casually looks away as if finished.
1.2–3.2s: the seeds SHOOT upward into three immense twisting stalks, unfurling huge leaves in rapid staggered succession. One central stalk curls beneath his boots like a living elevator and lifts him safely, keeping his body recognizable. Camera races backward and upward to reveal him riding this enormous branching plant formation; keep the floating roots finite against pure cyan, no landscape.
3.2–4.8s: the three colossal closed buds lean inward, then bloom in a rapid ONE-TWO-THREE sequence into huge leaf-and-pollen rosettes. The last bloom creates an oversized fist-shaped arrangement of leaves for one clear graphic beat, then showers golden pollen and outlined leaves. This is spectacular growth and empowerment, not an attack on another person.
4.8–6s: camera surges forward along the central curling vine to a confident chest-up BUDDY. Exact title "BUDDY BUDS" slams diagonally into the clear upper space on the final bloom, chunky comic burst and impact hold.
6–8s: pull back enough to reveal him comfortably seated on the enormous curled leaf like it is a lounge chair, flask in hand, camouflage bag nestled beside him, with three enormous blossoms framing the hero pose. He flicks one falling leaf off his shoulder and gives a relaxed grin. Hold the title and lush finishing tableau. Sound: tiny liquid drop, accelerating root cracks and vine whooshes, three explosive bloom pops with the last strongest, title slam, gentle leaf settling.
